data.gender_notes: Musmih is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘s-m-h’, meaning to pray, seek refuge, or flee. This name signifies one who is devoted to God and turns to Him in prayer and supplication. The name Musmih carries the meaning “One who prays” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musmih usually hope their child will grow to embody one who prays and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reflecting the importance of prayer in Islam, symbolizing a deep connection to the divine.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musmih total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
